non-blocking: the load snippet imports only numpy and ArchiveReader/ArchiveSignalLoader at line 121, then uses os, Path, json and GraphClient, which exist only in the earlier discovery snippet, so an agent copying the load block alone hits NameError at line 128 before any read.

non-blocking: find_signals opens a second FacilitySignal lookup beside imas_codex/graph/domain_queries.py:27, which owns the find-signals capability and is the one bound into the REPL namespace at imas_codex/llm/server.py:1575; the exact name/accessor predicate could have been a mode of the owner, and two functions of the same name now carry different semantics.

non-blocking: the coalesce(c.description, '') branch searches a property no writer sets — imas_codex/remote/pulse_catalogue.py:58 constructs PulseCategory with id, facility_id, archive and name only — so that half of the documented match surface cannot fire and every returned category description is null, while SKILL.md:109 tells the agent to select categories from their names/descriptions.
